pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, deep cinematic atmosphere)

A quiet stage
after the long night
a single light
resting in the dark

[Verse 1]
Drops of sweat fall
into silent space
each echo
a memory of the climb

In the mirror
I fell again and again
yet the small fire
never left my chest

[Chorus]
Hands rise slowly
toward the distant light

All those nights
gather in this moment

A quiet glow
surrounds the stage

And the heart
beats a little louder

[Verse 2]
Words that said
I could not go further
drift away
into distant air

Tears once hidden
now fall like rain
but somewhere
the light stays warm

Every step
every scar
has carried me here

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, cinematic and deeply reflective)

[Bridge]
The final note
hangs in the silence

Then suddenly
the quiet breaks

Voices rising
like distant stars

And for a moment
I stand still

[Chorus]
All the nights
become a single light

The stage beneath me
soft and endless

In this quiet sky
my story lingers

Like a star
finding its place

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, fading slowly)

The curtain falls
into gentle dark

But somewhere above

a small light
continues
to shine
